svg.title: I07 / GATEWAY CATSAT CONSOLE engineering mission profile
svg.desc: I07, GATEWAY CATSAT CONSOLE. Original project: CatSat Groundstation Command and Control. Session I: Aerospace Technology. Scientific question: Can operators accurately reconstruct spacecraft and image-transfer state when packets arrive late, out of order, with gaps, or across a simulated restart? Testable hypothesis: An event-sourced console with explicit stale-data indicators and state preconditions will reduce incorrect operator conclusions compared with a display that only shows the latest value.. svg.text: No project observations acquired · specified cases await execution · shared demonstrations are separately labeled
Extend CatSat ground-station work into a reproducible operations console
that connects image downlink, health telemetry, pass planning, and human
decision records. The current University of Arizona concept of operations
provides mission context; the historical FlatSat integration objective is
preserved as a local simulator. All requests and state transitions in this
research package are simulated. A mission-owner-approved adapter and
operational review would be required before any actual spacecraft
Can operators accurately reconstruct spacecraft and image-transfer state
when packets arrive late, out of order, with gaps, or across a simulated
TESTABLE HYPOTHESIS / NOT AN OBSERVED RESULT
An event-sourced console with explicit stale-data indicators and state
preconditions will reduce incorrect operator conclusions compared with a
display that only shows the latest value.
Transport delivery is distinct from instrument measurement validity and
The test bench owns its synthetic events and cannot contact a live ground
VALIDITY LIMITS / THE CLAIM STOPS HERE
A public operations description is not an interface-control document or
authorization to command CatSat. Local replay verifies software behavior and
operator interpretation, not radio-link performance or mission readiness.
